title: Message Preserved — Quiet Relay
motionDescription: Vesper Ink and Kuro Signal align and seal the incomplete record inside an archival kraft zine sleeve using a yellow binder clip and magenta tape; the rooftop parabolic dish switches on its quiet pilot LED and releases one delicate concentric silver-cyan pulse that dissolves into misty Moon City night under the halftone crescent moon.

reducedMotionAlternative.description: Serene wide Moon City ending frame with generous night-sky negative space, halftone crescent moon above, and quiet cyan beacon on the archive relay mast.

frames.actingNote: Kuro stands calmly beside the cyan CRT monitor watching as Vesper aligns the incomplete record inside a kraft zine folio.
Vesper fastens a yellow binder clip and magenta tape tab cleanly onto the folio beside the reel-to-reel deck while Kuro approves warmly.
Exterior cut to the rooftop parabolic dish and relay box under the full halftone moon; tiny amber-cyan LEDs switch on softly.
One delicate concentric silver-cyan radio wave leaves the parabolic dish while distant apartment windows illuminate warm gold in response.
Faint ripple dissolves into Moon City night haze while two calm shadowed silhouettes sit inside the amber loft window below.
Serene wide Moon City horizon with generous sky negative space, halftone crescent moon above, and one steady cyan beacon atop the relay tower.
